purpose: Final clean validation run of the frozen ASTFLOW retrieval system on the full CoIR AppsRetrieval TEST split. Measurement only: no tuning, no code changes to retrieval or evaluation.

git.run_branch: validation/final-test-run (worktree of origin/main, LFS smudge skipped: only the rejected E017 reranker checkpoint is in LFS)
git.frozen_retrieval_commit: 036060e (official run); only retrieval-path change since then: embeddings.py casts the model to float32 on CPU (db57806)

environment.cpu: Intel Core i7-14650HX (16 cores / 24 threads); torch limited to 4 threads by backend/app/retrieval/embeddings.py
environment.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop 8 GB present (driver 592.82) but NOT used: the frozen embedder runs on CPU
environment.cuda: not used (torch 2.14.0 CPU build in the evaluation venv)

system.model_hf_revision: e7f32e3c00f91d699e8c43b53106206bcc72bb22 (HF main; last changed 2025-07-04, before the official run)
system.precision: float32 (fp16 checkpoint cast to float32 at load)
system.document_encoding: one vector per corpus document, text = title + newline + text (titles are empty), L2-normalised
system.query_encoding: one vector per query, raw query text, L2-normalised, encoded live per query
system.similarity: dot product of L2-normalised vectors (cosine), exact over all 8,765 documents
system.candidate_threshold: documents with cosine <= 0.05 are dropped (search.py); no query was affected (every ranking has 1,000 documents)
system.tie_break: document id ascending on exactly equal scores
system.bm25: DISABLED (dense mode; lexical scores are computed but not used for ranking)
system.mmr: DISABLED (not implemented in the retrieval path)
system.reranker: DISABLED (E002, E011, E011b, E017 rejected; not in the product path)

timing.wall_clock: 2 h 52 min 18 s (including one-time model download)

query_latency_ms.note: per query: live query encoding + exact dense ranking + unused BM25 scoring, 4 CPU threads

artifacts.mteb/appsretrieval_results.json: MTEB 2.21.0 official scores (the TEST evaluation artifact)
artifacts.mteb/run_metadata.json: runner provenance, per-query latencies, diagnostic recall
artifacts.metrics.json: final metrics (repo definitions) + agreement with MTEB and pytrec_eval
